meaning:
attentive
Another spelling of qash.shuv (קַשֻּׁב "attentive" H7183B)

elsewhere.note: “Now, my God, let, I beg you, your eyes be open, and let your ears be attentive, to the prayer that is made in this place.
Let your ear now be attentive, and your eyes open, that you may listen to the prayer of your servant, which I pray before you at this time, day and night, for…
Lord, hear my voice. Let your ears be attentive to the voice of my petitions.
